map.比冲 = 推力 / (质量流率×g₀)。: Specific impulse = thrust / (mass flow rate × g0).
map.比冲越高推进效率越高。: The higher the specific impulse, the higher the propulsion efficiency.
map.由推力 F 与质量流率 ṁ 算比冲 Isp=F/(ṁ·g₀)，衡量发动机效率。: Compute the specific impulse Isp=F/(mdot·g0) from thrust F and mass flow rate mdot to measure engine efficiency.
map.对比化学推进与电推进的比冲量级，做任务选型。: Compare the specific-impulse magnitudes of chemical and electric propulsion for mission selection.
map.已知目标 Isp 与推力，反推需要的推进剂流量。: Given a target Isp and thrust, back-calculate the required propellant flow rate.
map.液氢液氧发动机比冲: Specific impulse of a liquid hydrogen/liquid oxygen engine
Thrust F=1000 N and mass flow rate mdot=0.4 kg/s. Isp=1000/(0.4×9.81)=1000/3.924≈255 s. A typical LH2/LOX vacuum Isp can reach 440+ s; the higher it is, the greater the impulse per unit propellant.
map.比冲单位为什么是秒？: Why is the unit of specific impulse seconds?
map.Isp=F/(ṁg₀)，量纲为秒，表示'每单位重量流量的冲量'。秒数越大发动机越: Isp=F/(mdot·g0) has the dimension of seconds, meaning the impulse per unit weight flow. The more seconds, the more propellant-efficient the engine. It can also be understood directly via the exhaust velocity v_e=Isp·g0 (m/s).
map.比冲高一定好吗？: Is a higher specific impulse always better?
map.对 Δv 效率越高越好，但常伴随低推力（电推）或复杂/昂贵系统（高室压、低温推进: For Δv efficiency higher is better, but it is often accompanied by low thrust (electric propulsion) or a complex/expensive system (high chamber pressure, cryogenic propellants). Trade off efficiency, thrust and cost by mission.
